decisive_spans.text: Thick blood smear: Plasmodium species present
Rapid diagnostic testing (Abbot BinaxNOW): positive for T1 (histidine-rich protein 2) and T2 (aldolase) antigens

response.rationale: The presence of T1 (histidine-rich protein 2) and T2 (aldolase) antigens on rapid diagnostic testing, along with a positive thick blood smear and 3.5% parasitemia, are highly indicative of Plasmodium falciparum malaria. While severe malaria (D3) is also supported by the symptoms and lab findings, D4 specifies the causative agent, which is more precise given the diagnostic test results.
